goal: Find a single-source, single-generative-core conditional scenario generator that works on IV-only, observed-anchor-only, and joint IV+anchor panels.
starting_model: 719a methodology/risk-manager baseline family, not a fixed checkpoint after real-VIX dimensionality update.
starting_experiment: Real-VIX tri-scope continuation after removing IV-derived vix_proxy.
scope: Unified state-normalized innovation conditional law over support-aware encoded market states. Different input/output heads and support transforms are allowed; separate stochastic sources or glued decks are not.

data_context.vix_source: Observed Yahoo Finance ^VIX via scripts/add_vix_to_multi_factor_data.py and scripts/download_multi_factor_data.py
data_context.forbidden_data_source: No IV-derived vix_proxy in active modeling.

constraints.research_log_mandatory: Every HEAD iteration appends RESEARCH_LOG.md via research-log-tail-append.

metric: Tri-scope acceptance: IV 11-suite plus anchor-only and joint panel realism/dependence/conditional-response scorecards.
compass: Real-VIX unified tri-scope conditional scenario generator
current_champion: No real-VIX tri-scope champion yet; rerun the 719a-style unified framework on IV-only, anchor-only, and joint with the updated 14-anchor panel.
